Kennedy Jr. removed all 17 members of CDC’s Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices and said replacements would be selected. child_drafts.title: HHS Announces Restructuring With Planned NIH Staff Reductions
child_drafts.description_short: HHS announced a restructuring that included planned NIH staffing reductions; Kennedy later said 220 NIH employees had been reinstated after a court blocked some layoffs.
child_drafts.description_medium: HHS announced its department-wide restructuring on April 1, 2025, including planned NIH workforce reductions. In June, Kennedy said 220 NIH employees had been reinstated after a federal judge blocked planned layoffs. The later figure is Kennedy’s account and does not establish that all planned cuts were reversed.
